acceptable-ads-summary.message: Adblock Plus allows a small number of nonintrusive, clearly labeled ads by default. They have to meet criteria set by the independent Acceptable Ads Committee. Large companies pay for allowlisting, smaller ones don't, and no one can pay to skip the criteria. You can turn this off in two clicks. Learn more about Acceptable Ads.
